title: CloudPipe — Cost Overview
description: Daily pipeline costs per subject from Kubecost allocation data. Populated after the nightly kubecost_scraper Prefect flow runs.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost FROM cloudpipe_metrics.costs WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo())
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_cost_usd), 2) AS mean_cost FROM cloudpipe_metrics.costs WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo())
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT subject) AS subjects FROM cloudpipe_metrics.costs WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo())

SELECT date, ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS daily_cost, ROUND(SUM(cpu_cost_usd), 2) AS cpu_cost, ROUND(SUM(memory_cost_usd), 2) AS memory_cost FROM cloudpipe_metrics.costs WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo()) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

panels.title: Cost by Subject (top 50)
panels.description: Placeholder — populated once the Kubecost labeling work (Phase 7) is complete.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT subject, ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(cpu_cost_usd), 2) AS cpu_cost, ROUND(SUM(memory_cost_usd), 2) AS memory_cost, COUNT(*) AS days FROM cloudpipe_metrics.costs WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE($__timeFrom()) AND DATE($__timeTo()) GROUP BY subject ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 50
